languages.note: Validation and probe scripts, not part of main build

direct.note: All deps are devDependencies. No runtime dependency declaration.

dependencies.transitiveCount: Minimal (esbuild platform binaries + vitest + react internals)

projectStructure.layout: monorepo-style with plugin-bos-light as primary package, adapters/ as secondary, agents/ as documentation/config

directories.plugin-bos-light/: Main plugin code: src/, tests/, dist/, widgets/, runtime-evidence/
directories.plugin-bos-light/src/: 44 TS/TSX source files, ~15K lines. Barrel index.ts re-exports 38 modules.
directories.adapters/gsdpi-local/: Server adapter for GSD-Pi local execution. Separate tsconfig.
directories.agents/: Div1-Div7 division definitions (config/docs, not executable code)
directories.configs/: Routing modes, tool permission matrix, division map JSON configs
directories.scripts/: ~30 JS/Python validation and probe scripts from prior milestones

structuralObservations.observation: No linting or formatting tool configured. No ESLint, Prettier, or Biome in package.json or lockfile. Zero code style enforcement.
structuralObservations.impact: Code style drift across contributors; no automated quality gate before commit.

structuralObservations.observation: No 'type': 'module' in package.json despite ESNext module target in tsconfig. Package defaults to CommonJS resolution, creating potential module resolution mismatches.
structuralObservations.impact: Import/export behavior may differ between tsconfig expectations and Node runtime.

structuralObservations.observation: 3 'as any' type casts in worker.ts bypass TypeScript strict mode checks. All in IPC message handlers.
structuralObservations.impact: Runtime type errors possible in worker message handling. Undermines strict mode benefits.

structuralObservations.observation: esbuild is a devDependency but no build script exists in package.json. Build process is undocumented/external.
structuralObservations.impact: New contributors cannot build the project from package.json alone. Build reproducibility at risk.

structuralObservations.observation: Adapter test (adapters/gsdpi-local/tests/execute.test.ts) uses node:test but vitest picks it up as empty suite, causing 1 suite failure. vitest.config.ts has no include/exclude to scope test discovery.
structuralObservations.impact: False test failure in CI. Adapter tests need separate runner or vitest config scoping.

structuralObservations.observation: tsconfig.json only includes plugin-bos-light/src and tests. Adapters directory is excluded from type checking.
structuralObservations.impact: Type errors in adapters/gsdpi-local go undetected by tsc.

structuralObservations.observation: Barrel index.ts re-exports 38 modules. All public API surface is flat - no namespacing or tiered exports.
structuralObservations.impact: Import tree shaking may be less effective. Harder to enforce module boundaries.

structuralObservations.observation: dist/ directory contains committed build artifacts (manifest.js 5KB, worker.js 38KB). These are stale relative to source and should be gitignored or generated in CI.
structuralObservations.impact: Stale dist can cause runtime bugs if deployed directly. Repo bloat from generated files.

structuralObservations.observation: No coverage reporting configured. vitest.config.ts has no coverage provider or thresholds.
structuralObservations.impact: Cannot measure or enforce test coverage. Regression risk invisible.

structuralObservations.observation: All 4 dependencies are devDependencies with zero production dependencies declared. React is listed as devDep despite being a runtime UI dependency.
structuralObservations.impact: No production dependency audit possible. Deployment may miss runtime deps.

structuralObservations.observation: Scripts directory has ~30 one-off validation/probe scripts from prior milestones (M011, M012). These are milestone-specific artifacts, not reusable tooling.
structuralObservations.impact: Scripts directory is cluttered with milestone-specific artifacts. No cleanup or archival policy.

structuralObservations.observation: vitest.config.ts sets pool: 'forks' (process isolation) but no other configuration. Default timeout, retries, and reporters are all implicit.
structuralObservations.impact: Test behavior depends on vitest defaults which may change across versions.
